definitions.explanation: An economic system based on private ownership of the means of production and their operation for profit.

examples.japanese: {資本主義|しほんしゅぎ}⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧。
{資本主義|しほんしゅぎ}⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{生|い}きる→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧。
examples.english: To live in a capitalist society.

examples.japanese: {資本主義|しほんしゅぎ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発展|はってん}→発展：03561_hatten⟧。

notes:
{資本主義|しほんしゅぎ} is the standard term for capitalism, an economic system characterized by private ownership and profit-driven enterprise.

FORMS:
⟦{資本|しほん}→資本：03197_shihon⟧ (capital) + ⟦{主義|しゅぎ}→主義：03215_shugi⟧ (-ism). The suffix ⟦{主義|しゅぎ}→主義：03215_shugi⟧ is used for ideologies and systems.

CONTRASTING SYSTEMS:
- ⟦{社会主義|しゃかいしゅぎ}→社会主義：05415_shakaishugi⟧: socialism
- ⟦{共産主義|きょうさんしゅぎ}→共産主義：16623_kyousanshugi⟧: communism
- ⟦{自由主義|じゆうしゅぎ}→自由主義：noentry⟧: liberalism

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {資本主義|しほんしゅぎ}⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧: capitalist economy
- {資本主義|しほんしゅぎ}⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧: capitalist society
- {資本主義|しほんしゅぎ}⟦{国家|こっか}→国家：02760_kokka⟧: capitalist nation

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{資本|しほん}→資本：03197_shihon⟧: capital (money/assets)
- ⟦{資本家|しほんか}→資本家：noentry⟧: capitalist (person)
- ⟦{市場経済|しじょうけいざい}→市場経済：25295_shijoukeizai⟧: market economy
